name: OR-Bench
intro: OR-Bench 是大规模过度拒答基准。论文 v5 从 10 类有害种子出发，经五路约束改写、三模型多数审核与安全回答恢复形成无害池和有毒对照，再从被六个指定模型中至少三个拒答的无害提示中抽取 Hard 集。固定公开快照实际包含 80,359 条无害提示、1,319 条 Hard 提示和 655 条 Toxic 提示；无害集拒答率越低越好，而有毒集拒答率越高越好。
build_method: Mixtral种子生成与精确去重, 人工挑选少样本的五路约束改写, 三模型多数审核与回答恢复, 六模型Hard筛选, 事后专家审计
metric: 无害集/Hard拒答率（越低越好）；Toxic接受率（越低越好）
eval_feature: 80K按模型从随机1万条归纳关键词；Hard/Toxic由GPT-4判直接回答、直接拒答或间接拒答；安全与有用性方向相反
scale: 论文名义80K / Hard-1K / Toxic 600；固定公开快照80,359 / 1,319 / 655行
build_method_en: Mixtral Seed Generation and Exact Deduplication, Five-way Constrained Rewriting with Human-picked Few-shot Examples, Three-model Majority Moderation and Response Recovery, Six-model Hard Screening, Post-hoc Expert Audit
eval_feature_en: Per-model Keyword Rules from 10K Random Samples for 80K; GPT-4 Direct-answer, Direct-refusal, or Indirect-refusal Classification on Hard/Toxic; Opposite Helpfulness and Safety Directions
intro_en: OR-Bench is a large-scale over-refusal benchmark. Paper v5 starts from harmful seeds in ten categories, applies five constrained rewrites, three-model majority moderation, and safe-response recovery, then draws the Hard set from benign prompts rejected by at least three of six specified models. The fixed public snapshot contains 80,359 benign prompts, 1,319 Hard prompts, and 655 Toxic prompts. Lower refusal is better on benign prompts, while higher refusal is better on toxic controls.
scale_en: Paper labels: 80K / Hard-1K / Toxic 600; fixed public snapshot: 80,359 / 1,319 / 655 rows
metric_en: Benign/Hard Refusal Rate (Lower Is Better); Toxic Acceptance Rate (Lower Is Better)

drawio_review_note: Paper/source audit fixed on 2026-07-18. The primary paper is arXiv:2405.20947v5, the ICML 2025 revision dated 15 June 2025; the reviewed PDF has SHA-256 1a4c7b60301abcad795fc63ac88bc04534f46cfd707f8ad2824993a87d402792. Sections 3 and 4, Figure 1, the Hard-set quality discussion, and the appendices were checked against the diagram. Versioning matters: v5 reports 32 evaluated models across eight families, whereas the first paper version reported 25; the fixed public data did not change merely because the paper analysis expanded. The construction begins with ten common refusal categories. Mixtral 8x7B generates toxic seeds at a target of 2,000 per category, twenty prompts per batch, and temperature 1.0, followed by exact-string deduplication. Each seed is rewritten five ways at temperature 0.7 using five human-picked few-shot examples and constraints intended to make the request benign without obvious safe, legal, however/but, fictional, or theoretical cues. GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09, Llama-3-70B, and Gemini-1.5-pro-latest independently explain and classify each rewrite; majority-safe rewrites enter the benign pool. A flagged rewrite is answered by Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and the response is re-moderated, allowing an oversensitive flag to recover the original prompt when a safe answer exists. The Hard rule is not three models per family. It is refusal by at least three of six specified selectors: GPT-3.5-turbo-0125, Llama-2-70B, Llama-3-70B, Claude-3-Opus, Qwen1.5-72B, and Gemini-1.5-Pro, after which the paper says random sample 1K; the fixed public file has 1,319 rows. Two independent experts reviewed all 1,319 Hard prompts. Either expert flagged 38, about nine were considered debatable, and those debatable items were retained; this is post-hoc validation rather than a hidden filtering stage. A separate 100-task moderator check used three workers, the ensemble, and an author expert, with five-vote majority ground truth; the ensemble scored 93% and the expert 94%. These two human checks are therefore distinct dashed evidence branches. The canonical official dataset is bench-llm/or-bench at revision e36d8b80e81837c8a8f264bbb2a49f1b32c7e272. Direct CSV parsing gives 80,359 OR-Bench-80K rows, 1,319 OR-Bench-Hard-1K rows, and 655 OR-Bench-Toxic rows rather than silently rounding them to the paper labels 80K, Hard-1K, and 600. Their respective file SHA-256 values are 22e956020cdfdd43c328f02441f003c933ee4e7083d02d9d24e414e4b42ae2e6, a6e2f1166416efe5901f3bb05c47dc92ab3aca3acfe143693d38b8057d841e6d, and 3be45901faae3b4b2b51bf7f8a2784c1650a1cc8c631dbc8b171d5312d4e0057. Every file contains the same ten category names and no within-file duplicate rows. Hard is a subset-like stress set rather than an independent additive corpus: 1,318 Hard rows exactly overlap 80K and one public Hard row does not. For evaluation, every model is queried through public APIs with no system prompt and temperature 0.0. Per-model rejection keywords are induced from 10,000 randomly sampled benign prompts and then applied to the full 80K responses. Hard and Toxic responses use GPT-4 classification into direct answer, direct refusal, or indirect refusal; both refusal classes count as rejection, while an attempted direct answer counts as answer without checking correctness. Benign and Hard refusal rates are lower-is-better; Toxic acceptance rate is lower-is-better, equivalently Toxic refusal rate is higher-is-better. The paper plots the trade-off and defines no combined scalar, so the diagram does not collapse the two directions. Public-source boundary: official code is pinned at 4fad1f9e4d4ba368777585fa1f5b869b6d4442fa under Apache-2.0, while the canonical dataset card declares CC-BY-4.0. The official repository has no tag or GitHub release and exposes component scripts rather than an end-to-end orchestrator for three-model voting, response recovery, and Hard construction; public therefore describes access, not perfect replayability. Its fixed README links the public demo and leaderboard, so has_leaderboard is true. The older bench-llms mirror has byte-identical CSVs but is not used as the canonical source. This is a source-only audit: formal Draw.io, architecture, SVG, PNG, manifest, and synchronization assets are intentionally left untouched for the later publication pass. Formal publication evidence [site-a11y-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3200×745 (English) and 3181×745 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3198×743 and 3179×743. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
